name: render-loop
title: useRenderLoop
description: A canvas drawing loop for WebGL and 2D effects: one context, a capped pixel ratio, resize, off-screen and hidden-tab pauses, reduced motion and context loss.
label: Labs examples
author: Design From Labs <https://labs.designfrom.com>

props.name: options.context
props.description: The context to create; three.js renderers take it as `context`. "none" creates none, for a renderer that creates its own (three.js WebGPURenderer, a React Three Fiber canvas): `setup` gets null.

props.name: options.setup / render / resize / dispose
props.description: Create the drawing state, draw one frame (return false while nothing is drawn yet, for an asynchronous renderer), size the buffer (default: CSS size x pixel ratio), release it.

props.name: options.continuous
props.description: Draw every frame, or only after invalidate() and resizes.

props.name: options.maxDpr
props.description: Upper bound for the device pixel ratio.

props.name: options.respectReducedMotion
props.description: Report "reduced-motion" and draw nothing when the user prefers reduced motion.

props.name: returns
props.description: status is pending, ready, unsupported, reduced-motion or lost; show a static fallback unless it is ready.

a11y: Reduced motion stops drawing by default, so the component can show a still picture instead.
Nothing is drawn while the canvas is off screen or the tab is hidden.
usage: const { status, invalidate } = useRenderLoop(canvasRef, { context: "webgl2", setup, render });
